project.description: The binding-agnostic engine vocabulary: the build-your-own-pipeline configuration API (attachments, passes, RenderPipeline, FrameGraph), flexible buffer-management interfaces, pluggable lighting models, and the runtime-manager seam (RuntimeManager/ResourceManager interfaces + VexelEngine). Depends on no shader compiler and no Vulkan binding, so a pipeline can be described, validated, and unit-tested with neither a GPU nor SupirVast present.
